title: Self-prediction residuals improve single-pass detection of wrong-object boxes in grounded vision-language models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28632v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Grounded vision-language models write boxes as text, and the mean probability of their coordinate tokens says little about whether a box is right. We study a single-pass signal for boxes on another object, which matter when only the object counts. A linear map, fitted per model to its own answers without labels, reads a box from the hidden state before writing. Its disagreement with the written box, the self-prediction residual, flags boxes on another object although the read-out is far less accurate; the residual's weight was fixed with labels on two models. On a replication list of 1,200 RefCOCOg test items, the residual, averaged over six models, raises the detection of these errors for each of fifteen single-pass scores, by 0.026 to 0.049 in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) on a label-free probe and probes trained on 2,000 labelled items. translated_title: 自预测残差改进接地视觉语言模型中对错误目标框的单次检测
translated_abstract: 接地视觉语言模型以文本形式输出边界框，而其坐标 token 的平均概率几乎无法说明一个框是否正确。我们研究了一种单次推理信号，用于检测指向其他物体的框——当只关注目标物体本身时，这类错误至关重要。我们为每个模型拟合一个线性映射（无需标签，仅基于模型自身的答案），在模型写出框之前从其隐藏状态中“读取”出一个框。该读出的框与实际写出的框之间的不一致，即“自预测残差”，能够标记出指向错误物体的框，尽管这种读出本身的准确度要低得多；残差的权重是在两个模型上用少量标签固定的。在一个包含 1,200 个 RefCOCOg 测试项的复现列表上，对六个模型取平均后，该残差在无标签探针以及在 2,000 个带标签样本上训练的探针上，为十五种单次得分中的每一种都提升了对此类错误的检测效果，AUROC（受试者工作特征曲线下面积）提升 0.026 至 0.049。对于所有错误，将其加入无标签探针后 AUROC 也得到提升（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出“自预测残差”方法——用无需标签拟合的线性映射从模型隐藏状态中读出一个框，其与实际输出框的不一致可作为单次推理信号，在六个模型上平均使十五种单次得分对“指向错误物体框”的检测 AUROC 提升 0.026 至 0.049。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "self-prediction residuals"—the disagreement between a box linearly decoded from hidden states (fitted label-free from the model's own answers) and the box actually written—as a single-pass signal that improves detection of wrong-object boxes in grounded vision-language models, raising AUROC by 0.026 to 0.049 across fifteen single-pass scores averaged over six models.
